PDS02.name: Browser fetch/WebSocket message chunks and UTF-8 decoding
key_ideas: Browser fetch exposes body chunks through a reader loop.
Server WebSocket ReceiveAsync may return partial message chunks and EndOfMessage is required.
Browser WebSocket onmessage gives full messages, not partial frames.
UTF-8 decoding across arbitrary byte chunks needs stateful Decoder/Decoder.Convert.

reading_quality.overall: Overall: medium-high/high. Main API shapes are clear.
limitations: Small code details should be verified against source images if exact syntax matters.
